title: Russian basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Russian (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/ru/rank.py and the OpenRussian.org dictionary; the two verbs of an aspect pair count as two words), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, written with ё and without stress marks, and its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word. The meaning shows where the word's stress falls (до́ма), except in words of one vowel and words with ё, which is always stressed.
